observations.statement: The T-013 climb converged within one family (airbench-style convnet, Nesterov SGD with lookahead, smoothed cross-entropy): 75.26% over 40 seeds at 8.25 epochs and 5.38 s local proxy; earlier levers varied hyperparameters, schedules and execution rather than representation.

The CIFAR-10 record code (hiverge, Fable e1-e5) and the competitor's programme contain strategies never tested on the converged recipe: hiverge Muon stack, SiLU, colour jitter, Fable flatten-max pool and CUDA graphs, lookahead flush, max+mean pooling and lineage hyperparameters.

omitted_dimensions.rationale: Single view is fixed by the rules; test-time augmentation and test-time adaptation are banned.

probes.method: One sweep at the converged recipe (8.25 epochs, 10 seeds 1300-1309) with in-sweep control: rep_branch, residual_start 0.3/0.5, PolyLoss-1, squentropy, superclass aux 0.3/1.0, ConvMixer-512/8 k5 p2.
probes.decision_rule: Promote any arm beating control by more than 2 combined SE at equal or lower time (or with time saving exceeding accuracy cost) to a fresh-seed confirmation.
probes.information_gain: Covers five distinct representation mechanisms in one pass.

probes.method: Coverage sweeps S21 (18 levers), S22 (hiverge Muon), S23 and S26a/b (execution, interleaved), S27 (momentum confirmation), m2 (CUDA graphs on A100 PCIe).
probes.decision_rule: Adopt only levers beating control beyond two combined SE on fresh seeds or, for execution levers, consistently across interleaved blocks.
probes.information_gain: Covers the full lineage and competitor strategy space.

question: Do representation or learning approaches outside the airbench convnet-SGD-CE family lower time to a 75% single-view CIFAR-100 mean?
synthesis: Coverage pass complete. Of every lineage and competitor strategy only Fable's flatten-max global pool and CUDA-graph compilation (max-autotune) survive: about 3% lower time at unchanged accuracy, now submission defaults. Muon (both ports), colour jitter, activations, whitening variants, cutout, mixup and hyperparameter changes do not transfer to single-view CIFAR-100. All five representation alternatives (progressive deepening, superclass loss, RepVGG branches, PolyLoss/squentropy, ConvMixer) were rejected; colour-space/DCT inputs are subsumed by whitening; ViT/MLP-Mixer and self-distillation stay dormant because their triggers were not met.
